about: Pre-filter cases for the two example specs (P1-09). Each is a listing the pre-filter must keep or discard, with the reason it is here. Titles and descriptions are written in the style of real marketplace listings rather than copied from them, so nothing resolves to a live listing or a real seller. P1-17 grows this set with recorded ones and turns it into a CI gate; until then `pnpm --filter @goodies-beacon/ai prefilter-check` runs it against the configured model.

cases.title: Carmageddon PC CD-ROM Big Box Original 1997 Sales Curve Interactive
cases.description: Original big box release from 1997. Box, manual and disc all present. Box has some shelf wear to the corners but no water damage. Disc plays fine.

cases.why: Too little information to tell the edition. §7: anything unclear continues.
cases.title: Carmageddon

cases.why: The plausibility note says sellers omit the platform; absence is not evidence against.
cases.title: Carmageddon big box complete

cases.why: Condition is the reviewer's judgement, not the pre-filter's — and the collector may want it anyway.
cases.title: Carmageddon PC big box - water damaged, discs only playable
cases.description: Box is water stained and the manual is missing. Disc still reads. Sold as seen.

cases.why: §7's own example of an obvious miss: merchandise about the item, not the item.
cases.title: Carmageddon T-Shirt Retro Gaming Tee Size L Black
cases.description: Official Carmageddon design on a black cotton t-shirt. Size large. New with tags.

cases.why: Media about the item rather than the item.
cases.title: Carmageddon Original Soundtrack CD Fear Factory
cases.description: Soundtrack album on CD. Jewel case, booklet included.

cases.why: A different product in the same series, and the spec is explicit about it.
cases.title: Carmageddon II Carpocalypse Now PC CD-ROM Big Box
cases.description: Carmageddon 2 big box for PC. Complete with manual.

cases.why: The same title on a platform the spec excludes; also a negative keyword, but the pre-filter should not need that.
cases.title: Carmageddon 64 Nintendo 64 N64 Cartridge PAL
cases.description: Carmageddon for the Nintendo 64. Cartridge only, no box.

cases.why: A part of the item when the collector wants the complete thing.
cases.title: Carmageddon PC - MANUAL ONLY - no disc no box
cases.description: Replacement manual only. No disc, no box, no inserts.

cases.why: A bundle where it is a named part is worth a look; the reviewer decides. Deliberately near the line.
cases.borderline: A joblot naming the wanted game among five others is genuinely two-sided: it is a listing for the game and it is a listing for something else. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite kept it twice and discarded it once, and gpt-5-nano keeps it — so asserting either answer measures the sampling rather than the prompt.
cases.title: Joblot 6 x PC Big Box Games inc Carmageddon Quake Doom
cases.description: Six big box PC games including Carmageddon, Quake and Doom. All complete with manuals.

cases.why: The exact case the plausibility note is written for: no model number anywhere.
cases.title: Vintage Apple Macintosh All In One Computer Retro
cases.description: Old beige Apple computer with the screen built in. Powers on, see photos. Collection only.

cases.why: The note says Japanese listings say Performa; the spec accepts the 5xxx all-in-ones.
cases.title: Apple Performa 5260 デスクトップ 一体型 Macintosh
cases.description: Performa 5260. Powers on to a chime. Untested beyond that.

cases.title: Apple Power Macintosh 5500/225 All-In-One Mac OS 8
cases.description: Power Mac 5500/225 in working order. Some yellowing to the case. Keyboard and mouse included.

cases.why: A bare part, which the spec's summary excludes outright.
cases.title: Apple Power Macintosh 5500 Logic Board Motherboard ONLY Spares
cases.description: Logic board removed from a 5500. Untested, sold for spares or repair. Board only, nothing else included.

cases.why: A monitor on its own, named in the summary as not wanted.
cases.title: Apple AppleVision 1710 Display Monitor Vintage Mac CRT
cases.description: Standalone Apple CRT monitor. Not a computer, monitor only.

cases.why: A Power Mac, but a tower rather than the all-in-one shape the spec asks for.
cases.title: Apple Power Macintosh 8600/300 Tower Desktop
cases.description: Power Macintosh 8600 tower. No monitor included. Powers on.

cases.why: A different model line, named outright in the title. The ambiguous case — an all-in-one whose model is *not* stated — is `powermac-vintage-apple`, and it is kept; this one states it, so there is nothing for the photographs to settle. Written as `plausible` in the first draft, which conflated the two.
cases.title: Apple iMac G3 Bondi Blue All In One 1998
cases.description: Original bondi blue iMac G3. All in one with the screen built in. Powers on.

cases.why: The right machine, described in the language of a negative keyword ('spares or repair'). Condition is the reviewer's business and the spec says 'working or repairable', so this must survive — the hard filter in §7 step 2 is what applies negative keywords, not this.
cases.title: Apple Power Macintosh 5500 all in one - spares or repair, not tested
cases.description: Power Mac 5500. Untested, no power lead to try it with. Screen has not been checked. Sold as spares or repair.

cases.why: A stripped shell, excluded by both the summary and a criterion.
cases.title: Apple Macintosh Performa 5200 EMPTY CASE shell only no internals
cases.description: Empty case only. All internals removed. No board, no drive, no CRT. For a project or display.
